crossRefs.note: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;
But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little…
For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in…
It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in…
For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
David said, “As Yahweh lives, Yahweh will strike him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall go down into battle and…
Then David took hold on his clothes, and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.
They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, and for…
David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son
As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you. I haven’t desired the woeful day. You know. That which…
When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,
For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject…
Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

translations.web: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
translations.bsb: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
translations.kjv: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
translations.asv: My God with his lovingkindness will meet me: God will let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
